rust_summary:
models no blockstate names, baked for drawing (`native_standalone_models`,
`native_draw_model`).
doc_summary: models no blockstate names, as NeoForge's `ModelEvent.RegisterStandalone`: `native_standalone_models(models)`, asked once at start, takes the ids of models a block entity or a mob draws as parts (`mymod:block/shaft_half`, from `assets/mymod/models/block/shaft_half.json`), and every resource load, a pack reload included, bakes them beside the block models. `native_draw_model(draw, model, tint)` draws one under `draw`'s pose in `native_block_entity_submit` or `native_mob_submit`, as `native_draw_block` draws a block's model, with `tint` (0xRRGGBB) on its tinted faces. A model that doesn't read is logged and left out, and drawing it gives false; no block has to be registered just to bake a part's model. Bundles that use them need `"hooks": @API:standalone_models@`.
